versions.title: The Hooded Circle

skins.name: Moonveil Hermit
skins.story: She hid in the empty observatory for a hundred nights, and now the pale crescent she prayed to shines on her own chest.

skins.name: Bloodthorn Hexer
skins.story: He traded his voice for a curse, so he hides his mouth behind a crimson veil and lets the thorns on his chest speak for him.

skins.name: Venom Mystic
skins.story: The serpents of the flooded cellar taught her their language, and the fangs on her cobra hood are the only thing they asked for in return.

versions.note: When the academy fell silent, three mages pulled up their hoods and kept practising in the dark: a hermit of the moon, a hexer of blood and a mystic who speaks with serpents.

versions.title: Crowns of the Fallen Tower

skins.name: Starfall Archmage
skins.story: He mapped every star from the top of the fallen tower, and the ones that fell from the sky now shine on the hat he pulls low over his golden eyes.

skins.name: Solar Magus
skins.story: The last keeper of the sun hall wears a golden circlet that still holds one morning of light, and he spends it a ray at a time.

skins.name: Crystal Enchantress
skins.story: She slept too long beside the tower’s power crystal, and when she woke, magenta shards had grown from her brow like a crown.

versions.note: High in the broken tower, three masters still wear the marks of their rank: a star-hatted archmage, a magus crowned with the sun and an enchantress grown out of crystal.

versions.title: Echoes of the Empty Academy

skins.name: Wisp Warden
skins.story: He died keeping the lanterns lit, and now his spectral halo and the lantern at his belt are the only lights that walk the empty corridors at night.

skins.name: Bonecrown Necromancer
skins.story: Crowned with the bones of the old headmasters, he keeps the crypt under the academy and lets no student rest until the lessons are finished.

skins.name: Gale Dervish
skins.story: She spins through the shattered windows of the academy, and the pale blue wind wrapped around her head never once touches the ground.

versions.note: Not everyone left the academy: a spirit still lights the halls, a necromancer guards the crypt below and a dervish rides the wind through the broken windows.
